slides: The Institute for Construction, Urban and Economic Research (hereafter, the Institute) was established under Decision No. 29/QĐ/THXDVN of 16 April 2013 by the Presidium of the Vietnam Federation of Civil Engineering Associations

More than 10 years of experience, over 20 outstanding young staff and specialists alongside many leading experts in planning, urban development and urban economics — we have designed cities that are smart, green and environmentally friendly, balanced between function, resilience and the needs of the community
Scientific research, applied research and technology development in construction, consultancy, urban development planning, urban economics, construction economics and environmental protection.

Transfer of scientific technology and green transition. Delivering information services and organising conferences and workshops at home and internationally. Partnership and collaboration with domestic and international organisations across planning, urban development and environmental protection effectively , and connectivity — building cities ready for the future .
Leading the city-wide planning initiative for Đà Nẵng across class 1 and class 2 cities — a transformative project reflecting our commitment to whole-picture strategy and real-world results.

Research and preparation of schemes and planning projects, urban and rural planning; housing development programmes; urban economics and the urban environment; construction investment; real-estate market information; procurement and tendering…
